summary: ATS Corporation filed a Form 6-K reporting voting results from its annual general meeting of shareholders held on August 6, 2026. All director nominees were elected, Ernst & Young was reappointed as auditor, and the non-binding executive compensation resolution was approved. A shareholder proposal to amend By-Law No.1 was not approved. The filing is routine disclosure of routine shareholder meeting outcomes and does not constitute a special situation.
